text:
Aisha: Heads up — CI is failing for audit-event-validator after the RBAC header change. Keystore update fixture now shows null actor and tests assert presence. Need triage.
Lucas: Link to the failing job? paste the failing test name.
Aisha: https://ci.internal/redwood/job/1234
Aisha: failing test: TestKeystoreEventEnrichment
Aisha: log snippet:
```
{ "event_type": "keystore.update", "actor": { "id": null }, "kms_key_id": "projects/prod/keys/k1" }
AssertionError: expected actor.id to be truthy
```
devsec-bot: CI job audit-validator-e2e #1234 FAILED — 8 failures, regression introduced in commit abcdef1 (rbac: remove service identity header enrichment). Please triage.
Jon: Did we remove the middleware that injects actor metadata? that's a runtime change, not schema.
Priya: Could be two issues: RBAC header change + KMS key rotation path that emits system events with no actor. We should either relax validator to allow null actor for system events OR ensure enrichment runs earlier.
Lucas: Quick reproduce locally:
```
make audit-validate SAMPLE=keystore.update
# shows same assert
```
Aisha: I'll try to reproduce and open a minimal PR to either patch fixture or the validator. If we relax validator, we must add a clear allowlist like `actor.optional_for_system: true` and tie it to event_type.
Jon: prefer fixing enrichment. Any chance the service proxy dropped X-User header? @infra?
Priya: If we fix enrichment it'll take longer. For immediate unblocking, patch the golden fixture to include an explicit system actor ("system") and add a CI exemption note.
Aisha: I'll push branch `fix/keystore-null-actor-ci` and request Priya review. Will run CI after patch. @e2e-bot can you rerun after PR?
e2e-bot: Rerun queued on branch fix/keystore-null-actor-ci — ETA ~8m :eyes:
devsec-bot: Note: customers may see missing actor on audit events during RBAC rollout; flagged to security-runbook. Ops, please watch 5xx spikes on keystore endpoints. :warning:
Lucas: Thanks — keep thread updated. :thumbsup:
